title: local-task: queue_alloca FAILED_PRECONDITION on chained eager invokes
body:
A short chain of eager iree-turbine compute ops on `local-task` fails with `FAILED_PRECONDITION` from `iree_hal_local_transient_buffer_*` during a `hal.device.queue.alloca` call. This is a new failure starting in the `3.12.0rc20260429` nightly.

This is minimized from an `iree-turbine` test: [`tests/dynamo/tensor_test.py::TensorTest::test_nn_linear`](https://github.com/iree-org/iree-turbine/blob/e38379a0b06ca910673ed4d3c3b29a1f3a398929/tests/dynamo/tensor_test.py#L96-L105)

### Repro

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install --pre --find-links https://iree.dev/pip-release-links.html \
  iree-base-compiler==3.12.0rc20260429 \
  iree-base-runtime==3.12.0rc20260429 \
  iree-turbine==3.10.0rc20260430
pip install 'torch<=2.10.0,>=2.5' --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
python repro.py
```

`repro.py`:

```python
import torch
from iree.turbine.dynamo import TurbineMode
from iree.turbine.runtime import Device

with TurbineMode():
    Device("local-task").set()
    try:
        a = torch.randn(2, 3).to("turbine")
        a = a.detach()
        a = a + 1
        out = a + 1
        print("PASS:", out)
    finally:
        Device.current().clear()
```

### Error output

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/.../repro.py", line 15, in <module>
    out = a + 1
          ~~^~~
  File "/.../iree/turbine/dynamo/tensor.py", line 87, in __torch_function__
    return super_fn(*args, **kwargs or {})
  File "/.../iree/turbine/dynamo/tensor.py", line 79, in super_fn
    return func(*args, **kwargs)
  File "/.../iree/turbine/dynamo/tensor.py", line 230, in __torch_dispatch__
    return compute_method(func, *args, **kwargs)
  File "/.../iree/turbine/dynamo/tensor.py", line 496, in compute_method
    ret_val = DeviceTensor.from_torch(torch.tensor(py_arg))
  File "/.../iree/turbine/dynamo/tensor.py", line 258, in from_torch
    dev_tensor = DeviceTensor._async_create_empty(
  File "/.../iree/turbine/dynamo/tensor.py", line 307, in _async_create_empty
    buffer = hal_device.queue_alloca(alloc_size, wait_semaphores, signal_semaphores)
RuntimeError: allocating memory on queue: c/runtime/src/iree/hal/local/transient_buffer.c:249: FAILED_PRECONDITION; transient buffer has not been committed; ensure the alloca signal semaphores are satisfied before accessing it
```

### Environment

- `iree-base-compiler==3.12.0rc20260429`
- `iree-base-runtime==3.12.0rc20260429`
- `iree-turbine==3.10.0rc20260430`
- `torch==2.10.0+cpu`

### Bisect

- Last passing nightly: `iree-3.12.0rc20260428`
- First failing nightly: `iree-3.12.0rc20260429`
- Diff: https://github.com/iree-org/iree/compare/iree-3.12.0rc20260428...iree-3.12.0rc20260429
- Suspect commit: add699f971
